name: gpereira-harness
description: Portable Claude Code harness: twelve skills (orchestrator, agent-selector, task-observer, agent-watchdog, plan-arbiter, visual-plan, adhd, for-junior-dev, research, resolving-merge-conflicts, handoff, ux-review), four named worker agents, four-tier model routing (API-with-fallback), start-ticket, create-pr and review-queue commands, worker-conduct and return-contract checks on every subagent dispatch, safety hooks (bash clause, secret scan, credential files, docs location), session and compaction handoffs, and an Obsidian-compatible context store. No MCP registrations bundled by design.
